verses.text: Ach anima, al t'a heb' etisraelal kajan t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Israel to smaklej yab' in lolonel heb'.
Ha in wal Jehová Yajal in swala': Ha heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex, ix skomon alej heb' to yikxo masanil lum tzalkixtak heb' aytaxoni.
Ayik ix smakanek' juntzanhxo nación chi' lum tzalkixtak t'a yol he makb'en chi' yikej, ix satanel heb' tastak ay t'a sat lu'um, ix ex sb'uchan heb'.

Yuj chi', a in Jehová Yajal in swal t'ayex israel ex ayex t'a lum tzalkixtak, t'a lum ch'olkixtak, t'a chonhab' mak'b'ilem lanhnajok yet' t'a chonhab' kannak tzinan, haton juntzanh chonhab' elk'ab'ilb'at tastak ay t'ay yuj juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil.

Yuj chi' yet' wal yowal in k'ool swalan t'a yib'anh chonhab' Edom yet' juntzanhxo nación icha tik: Tzalajk'olal ix aj eyoch t'a in chonhab', yet' wal he chichonk'olal ix eyik'anek' lum lum, ix he satanel tastak ay t'a sat lu'um, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha in Dios Yajal in swal t'ayex israel ex tik, ex kajan ex t'a lum tzalkixtak, t'a lum jolomtak witz, t'a lum ch'olkixtak yet' t'a lum pak'kiltak: Ay wal kot yowal in k'ol t'a yib'anh juntzanhxo nación chi' eyuuj, yujto tzex yixtej wal heb', tzex sb'uchan heb'.
Yuj chi' swak' in ti' to a juntzanh nación chi', a in ol wak' k'ixwelal heb'.
Ha t'a lum tzalkixtak t'a yol he makb'en, jantak te' awb'en te' ol yak' sat, yik ol he lo sat te', yujto toxo ol ex meltzajok.
Ha in wal ol ex in tanhwej, ol ex k'ochxok, ol eyawanxi eyawb'en t'a sat lum he lu'um chi'.
Elanhchamel ol wak'xi k'ib' he b'isul t'a lum he lu'um chi. Ol laj k'ib' he b'isul t'a junjun he chonhab'. Ol laj he b'oxik'e he chonhab' mak'b'ilem lanhnajok.

Ol wak' k'ib' sb'isul nok' he molb'etzal nok', ol k'ib' pax he b'isul. Jantak anima ol kajnajxok t'a junjun he chonhab', ek'b'al swach'il ol ex ajxok icha heyaj pekataxo. Icha chi' ol aj eyojtakaneli to a in ton Jehová in swutej icha chi'.
Ol ex wik'b'at t'a lum tzalkixtak chi', ol eyik'anxikan lum eyiktaxon yaji. Manhxo ol miljokcham heb' eyuninal t'a juntzanh lu'um chi'.

Ha heb' anima t'a juntzanhxo nación syal heb' to a lum tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Israel tz'ak'ancham heb' anima yet' yuninal. Palta a in Jehová Yajal in swala' to manhxa b'ak'inh ol satel heb' in chonhab' yuj lum lum chi', manhxo ol chamlaj yuninal heb' yuj lu'um.
Manhxa b'ak'inh ol ex in cha b'uchjok yuj juntzanhxo nación t'a lum he lu'um chi', manhxa anima ol cham yuj lu'um, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, ayik kajanek' heb' he mam eyicham t'a sluum t'a pekataxo, yixtejnakb'at lum sluum heb' chi' yuj chukal sk'ulej. Ha sb'eyb'al heb' chi' yajb'entak t'a wichanh.
Yuj chi' wak'nak wal kot yowal in k'ol t'a yib'anh heb', yujto jantak anima smilnakcham heb' t'a sat sluum chi', ochnak pax heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios.
Yuj wal schukal sb'eyb'al heb' chi', wak'och syaelal heb', in saklemejkanb'at heb' t'a juntzanhxo nación.

Haxo yik sk'och heb' t'a juntzanhxo nación chi', te chuk yal heb' anima chi' t'ayin yuj heb', yalan heb' anima chi' icha tik: Tato yel schonhab' Jehová yaj juntzanh anima tik, ¿tas yuj tz'ik'jiel heb' t'a schonhab' chi'? xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' wab' wal syail yuj juntzanh b'uchwal lolonel, yuj smul heb' he mam eyicham chi', chuklaj tas syal heb' anima chi' t'ayin t'a juntzanh nación b'aj k'ochnak heb' chi'.

Yuj chi', al t'a heb' etisraelal chi' to a in Jehová Yajal in swal icha tik: Ha tas ol in k'ulej, manh eyujok ol in k'ulej, palta yuj wak'an b'inaj in b'i, yujto te chuk yalan heb' anima chi' t'ayin eyuuj, haton heb' b'ajtak k'ochnak ex kan chi'.

Yuj chi' ol in ch'ox wal sniwanil welk'och t'a yichanh juntzanh nación ix in b'uchan eyuuj chi'. Ha in wal Jehová Yajal in swala' to a t'ayex ol in ch'oxel sniwanil welk'ochi, t'a yichanh heb' anima chi'. Ichato chi' ol nachajel yuj heb' to a in ton Jehová in swutej icha chi'.
Ha in ol ex wik'elta t'a skal juntzanh nación b'aj sakleminak eyajkanb'at chi', ol ex in molb'anxi, ol ex wik'anxib'at t'a he lu'um chi'.
Ol ex in sakb'itanxi yuj juntzanh chukal ix he k'ulej, icha junok tas sb'ikjiel yet' ha ha' yaax. Ol wik'anel he mul yuj b'aj ex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios.
Ol wak'och jun ak' pensar t'ayex sk'exulok jun he chuk pensaril chi'. Ol wik'anel jun pensar pit ayoch t'ayex, haxo k'anab'ajumal ol wak'och t'ayex.
Ol wak'och Wespíritu t'ayex yik tze b'eyb'alan in k'ayb'ub'al yet' in cheknab'il.
Ol ex kajnajxok t'a lum wak'nak t'a heb' he mam eyicham, ol ex ochxok in chonhab'ok, a inxo ol in ochxok he Diosalok.
Ha in ol ex in tanhwej, yik wach' manhxo ol eyixtejb'at he b'a yuj juntzanh chukal tze k'ulej chi', ol wak'anxi yak' sat ixim he trigo, yik wach' manhxa b'ak'inh ol eyak' wejel.
Ol wak' wal yak' sat te eyawb'en te' yet' masanil tastak tzeyawej t'a sat lu'um, yik wach' manhxo ol ex b'uchjok yuj juntzanhxo nación yuj eyak'an wejel.
Ayik ol he naankot he chuk b'eyb'al yet' tas yajb'entak he k'ulejnak, ol ex k'ixwok yuj.
Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Ojtakejekel ex israel ex tik to manh yujok he wach'il swak'an in wach'k'olal t'ayex, yujto smoj eyekan k'ixwok he b'a yuj he chuk b'eyb'al chi'.
Ha in Jehová Yajal in swal icha tik: Ha wal yik ol wik'anel he chukal, ol ex wak'anxi kajnaj t'a he chonhab', ol he b'oanxik'ei.
Ha lum lum kannak tzinan chi', ol awchajxi awb'en t'a lu'um, haxo yik ol ek' heb' anima ta', ol yilan heb' to ayxo tas awab'il t'a lu'um.

Ol yalan heb' icha tik: Ha jun lum lum tik kannak tzinan lu'um, haxo tiknaik ayxo tas awab'il t'a lu'um, lajanxo yilji lum icha lum Edén. Mak'b'ilem lanhnaj juntzanh chonhab' tik, haxo tiknaik ix laj b'ochajxik'ei, ayxo pax anima kajan t'ay, xcham heb'.

Ha juntzanh chonhab' aykan t'a he lak'anil, ol yojtakejel heb' to a in Jehová in tik tzin b'oxik'e tas mak'b'ilem lanhnajok, ichato swawejxiem tas tok'b'ilk'eta. Ha in Jehová in swala', yowalil ol elk'och tas swalkan tik.
Ha in Jehová Yajal in swal icha tik: Ex yinhtilal Israel, a tastak ol he k'an t'ayin, ol wak' t'ayex. Ol wak'an k'ib' he b'isul icha tz'aj sk'ib' sb'isul nok' kalnel.

Ha juntzanh chonhab' emnak lanhnaj chi', ol b'ut'jokxiel yuj heb' anima, lajanxonhej ol aj yek' heb' anima chi' icha yek' nhililok nok' kalnel tz'ik'chajkot silab'il t'a Jerusalén t'a k'inhal. Icha chi' ol aj eyojtakaneli to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb', xchi t'ayin.
